reviewer: Codex and Astra independent direct image inspection

findings.description: V219 crouch and sit renders continue to expose the upper surfaces of both white trouser thighs. The front apron falls below and to the outside of the raised knees rather than covering both thighs.
V219 left and right profile renders still show the front apron hem and its pointed end projecting forward beyond the leg silhouette.
V219 prone render still shows diverging inner and outer lilac-edged hem contours under the pelvis, so the apron edge reads as doubled.

nextAction: V219 passed production build, cloth simulation, skin/export, rendering and geometry audit but direct Codex/Astra review rejects the visible garment. Do not repeat the front-Y cutoff or row-width experiment. For V220, use the current crouch/sit/prone meshes and coverage diagnostics to change the pose-aware front-lap deformation so it spans both anterior thigh surfaces and suppresses the unsupported forward hem projection; then inspect the prone boundary for a single continuous edge. Keep all fit, orientation and area limits intact. Shape Key, Unity/VRChat runtime, package and release remain unverified.
